verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenCode can add external tools via MCP, let users create their own custom agents, and load reusable skills. None of these is a documented way to integrate third-party, partner-built agent apps such as a marketplace or partner-agent catalog. MCP tools and user-authored agents are adjacent capabilities, not the story itself.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
